★Request
Image of Victoire Pisa nodding

From this jewel... I can feel...
a profound loneliness conveying itself to me.

This place is overflowing with so many cherished feelings too.
I love talking with others... so I can't help getting a bit excited♪

Hehe... Your smile...
is so... so very radiant...

—... If I may ask... for example...
how about a place connected to your mother?

What a curious pair you two are... To tell the truth... I feel as though long ago...
my mother once spoke of inheriting some jewelry.

Um... excuse me.
By any chance... does this earring look familiar to you?

They even have all kinds of turquoise from around the world on display...
I've been looking forward to this for so long♪

I apologize for the sudden intrusion. But from your gaze,
I sensed a profound affection... along with a tiny flicker of hope.

Even the smallest detail... could become a vital clue
in bringing the pair of earrings together once more.
Or perhaps... the sorrow... and the earnest wishes of those longing for a reunion.
Could it be... inside here...?

An old chest of drawers... There is a large antique chest
in the room that used to be my mother's private quarters. Allow me to guide you there.

And so, alongside Victoire Pisa and her light, bouncing steps,
I enjoyed the jewelry exhibition, but—

You're right. It wouldn't be found so easily.
Still, where else could we possibly look...?

Recognizing and cherishing the bonds and encounters among people, jewels, and all things...
she truly wishes with all her heart to save everything that suffers in solitude.

Oh... by all means! Hehe... It makes me so happy
that you're taking an interest in jewels too, Trainer♪
Trainer...
Ah... thank goodness. With this, they can be connected once more.

She is prepared to devote herself fully to reconnecting irreplaceable bonds.
—With all my heart, I conveyed that I wanted her to believe in Pisa.

Though... it's probably just my imagination.
Forgive me for bringing up such a strange story...

Not at all, it is deeply intriguing.
If you wouldn't mind... could you share just a little more with us?
Reuniting the pair of earrings, connecting their happiness—...
An earring only for the right side...

...Yes, they are the same piece. We may not be able
to place it right beside the other immediately, but someday, surely—

Huh...? 
What are you saying...?

Turn here... and it's that building over there.
—...Oh? ...Trainer!

Even if it's only one half... if it is something of value...
it may have been gently... and carefully tucked away.

...According to the caption, the other half...
"was scattered during inheritance, and its current whereabouts are unknown"... it says.

Yes, to the museum.
Hehe... They're holding a limited-time jewelry exhibition right now.
The elderly woman gently lifts the lid. And then—
This is it...! To think we would truly find it...!

Just then, I notice an elderly woman standing beside Victoire Pisa.
She, too, was gazing intently at the earring, as if lost in time.

—...This jewel...
...carries such a sorrowful color...

I've watched my parents work by their side for so long, after all...
Hehe... Jewels are surprisingly talkative little things, you know.

(You stay right by my side, no matter what.
In that case, today... I must make it a wonderful day.)

Where her gaze fell, a turquoise earring was displayed.
However—

(...—It's welling up.
Reaching me so clearly, overflowing...)

Victoire Pisa lets slip a smile brimming with compassion.
It was the smile of an angel, rejoicing and celebrating a reunion.
Trainer...

Ah, it's truly exquisite... And this one...
seems to have been deeply cherished by its owner for a very long time.

I must say, I'm surprised... Yes... I felt as though I'd seen something
very similar to this jewelry when I was a child...

—...If it's anywhere, it would be at my family home.
I'll arrange things with the family, so please come search for it.

Among all gems, she especially loved turquoise.
Listening to her speak so happily about them naturally sparked my own interest.

Could the owner's wish...
"that they might meet again"... be imbued within it...?
Why... would you go so far for this...?
The sparkle lingering in your heart... Let us go find it together♪

This jewelry box... must hold quite a bit of sentiment.
It's very old, yet there are traces of it having been repaired many times...

(Treating it as if it were your own concern...
You're aligning your heart... with mine.)
—...Could it be...

To verify our findings, we returned once more
to the jewelry exhibition with the earring we had discovered.
In front of one particular showcase, her expression clouded over.
If they can be connected... I want to reconnect them once more.

The space beside it... has been left empty.
Almost as if it's waiting for its other half...

Ah... I can feel it so clearly.
Your joy... your happiness.
Would you please... lend us your aid?

Oh, my...! Look, Trainer!
This diamond has such a magnificent cut...!
It doesn't appear to be... in any of the jewelry boxes gathered here.

What a magnificent chest... Could it possibly be in here...?
—............Ah...!
